requirements.location: Complete report plan sections2–9 and all U01–U11 contributions.
requirements.basis: Read the full task and complete outline. Facility form and operating/ownership arrangement are separated, preserving self-operated fresh inventory, social warehouses, franchise/cooperation and store-picking comparisons. The timeline includes exits and accounting/reclassification issues; geography uses catchments and comparable periods rather than national density. Two operator models and a separate platform bridge retain refunds, subsidy funders, losses, labor, delivery, inventory funds and headquarters allocations without double counting. U08–U11 explicitly connect breakeven demand to hourly capacity, network diversion and step costs, covering the task's main nonlinearity requirement. Mature-area and new-region recommendations are differentiated. Required responsibility/flow, region/mode and auditable model/sensitivity exhibits are all assigned; real inputs remain to be established.
